2609.27489.title: Passing: An Endless Journey through Reconstructed Spacetime with AI-Generated Sound
2609.27489.paper_summary: This paper introduces Passing, an interactive audiovisual installation that generates an endless journey from a single continuous monorail-window recording by reconstructing it as a spatiotemporal volume. Rather than replaying the footage linearly, the work resamples its spatial and temporal structure along nonlinear trajectories, producing a continuously passing landscape whose depth, speed, and temporal order become unstable. A camera-based viewer-presence detection system estimates whether a viewer is present in the viewing zone and uses this presence state to influence transitions among rendered video sequences. The resulting video stream is fed into SpecMaskFoley, a real-time video-to-audio synthesis model that generates a synchronized soundscape for the reconfigured image. The model is not used to reconstruct an objectively correct soundtrack, but functions as a speculative listener, proposing a possible auditory interpretation of a world whose conventional spatial and temporal premises have been disrupted. Passing distributes creative agency across the artist, who defines the rules of spacetime reconstruction; the AI model, which interprets the emergent visual flow as sound; and the audience, whose embodied presence influences the audiovisual trajectory. Through this structure, the work investigates how authorship and listening may be negotiated among human intention, machine inference, and audience interpretation. Artwork page: https://ryufurusawa.com/passing
2609.27489.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文介紹了《Passing》，一個互動式視聽裝置，它通過將單一連續的單軌窗戶錄影重構為一個時空體，生成一段無盡的旅程。這個作品並不是線性地重播錄影，而是沿著非線性軌跡重新取樣其空間和時間結構，產生一個持續變化的景觀，其深度、速度和時間順序變得不穩定。基於相機的觀眾存在檢測系統估算觀眾是否在觀賞區域內，並利用這一存在狀態來影響渲染視頻序列之間的轉換。生成的視頻流被輸入到SpecMaskFoley，一個實時視頻到音頻合成模型，該模型為重新配置的圖像生成同步的聲音景觀。該模型並不是用來重建一個客觀正確的聲音軌道，而是作為一個推測性的聽眾，提出一種可能的聽覺解釋，該世界的傳統空間和時間前提已被打破。《Passing》將創造性代理分配給藝術家，他定義了時空重建的規則；AI模型，它將新興的視覺流解釋為聲音；以及觀眾，他們的具體存在影響視聽軌跡。通過這一結構，該作品探討了作者身份和聆聽如何在人的意圖、機器推理和觀眾解釋之間進行協商。藝術作品頁面：https://ryufurusawa.com/passing
